# kintone_apps (Data Source)

Lists all matching published apps. Requires password authentication; general settings are not fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Listing requires password authentication.
data "kintone_apps" "example" {
  name = "Customer"
}

output "matching_apps" {
  value = data.kintone_apps.example.apps
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `codes` (Set of String) App listing filter, up to 100 values. IDs are positive decimal strings.
- `ids` (Set of String) App listing filter, up to 100 values. IDs are positive decimal strings.
- `name` (String) App name search filter, at most 64 characters.
- `space_ids` (Set of String) App listing filter, up to 100 values. IDs are positive decimal strings.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) All matching app metadata, ordered by numeric app ID. An empty result is an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Published app code.
- `created_at` (String) Published app created_at.
- `creator` (Attributes) App creator. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--creator))
- `description` (String) Published app description.
- `id` (String) Published app id.
- `modified_at` (String) Published app modified_at.
- `modifier` (Attributes) App modifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--modifier))
- `name` (String) Published app name.
- `space_id` (String) Published app space_id.
- `thread_id` (String) Published app thread_id.

Read-Only:
